plugins.name: cc-session-pool
plugins.description: Gives every session a tool to compact its own conversation and wakes the session afterwards, a tool that reports the size of its own context where the plugin's mod runs and Claude Code accepts the mod's tool, and gives a dispatcher session the tools that manage its worker sessions in Terminal windows.
